objective: Al terminar demuestras que hablas de trabajo con colocaciones, cláusulas de tiempo, modales en pasado y respondes como en una entrevista.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad 3: colocaciones de trabajo, when / as soon as / until, had to / managed to, carta y entrevista.

input.recap_es: Repasa: colocaciones de trabajo, cláusulas de tiempo con presente, had to / didn't have to, could / was able to / managed to, la carta de presentación y las respuestas de entrevista.

md_es: - *apply for a job · meet a deadline · be in charge of · be responsible for · work overtime*
- *When I finish, I'll … · as soon as I get … · I won't leave until you come · by the time you arrive*
- *I had to work late · We didn't have to wear a uniform · I could swim at five · I managed to finish it*
- *I am writing to apply for … · I would be grateful if … · Yours sincerely / faithfully*
- *I tend to …, but now I … · For example, …*

exercises.prompt: Une cada expresión con su categoría.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Aprende el tono de cada expresión.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Aprende el tono de cada expresión.

exercises.prompt: I need to ___ for the vacancy before Friday.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Apply for a vacancy.

exercises.prompt: She is ___ of a team of ten people.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Be in charge of.

exercises.prompt: When I ___ the job, I'll celebrate.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: When + presente.

exercises.prompt: I'll stay here until you ___.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Until + presente.

exercises.prompt: The girl ___ a white scarf is talking to him.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: With + accesorio.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday I ___ finish the report before six.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Obligación pasada: had to.

exercises.prompt: Escucha y escribe lo que oyes.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Post office = correo.

exercises.prompt: She ___ English since 2022.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Since + actividad que continúa: continuo.

exercises.prompt: The door was locked, but I ___ open it with a key.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Éxito concreto: managed to.

exercises.prompt: Dear Sir or Madam, … ___

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Sin nombre: faithfully.

exercises.prompt: I am writing ___ apply for the job of chef.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! I am writing to apply for…
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: I am writing to apply for…

exercises.prompt: I look forward ___ hearing from you.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Look forward to + -ing.

exercises.prompt: We ___ have to wear a uniform last year. (no teníamos que)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Didn't have to.

answer: As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Después de as soon as, presente.

exercises.prompt: ¿Qué hará cuando termine el contrato?
exercises.audio_text: When I finish this contract, I'll apply for a promotion. Until then, I have to work overtime almost every week.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Dice: I'll apply for a promotion.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice: I'll apply for a promotion.

exercises.prompt: Cuando termine este proyecto, tendré que buscar otro trabajo.
answer: When I finish this project, I'll have to look for another job.
When I finish this project, I will have to look for another job.
When I finish this project I'll have to find another job.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: When + presente; will have to.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un párrafo (8 a 10 frases) sobre tu experiencia laboral o tus planes: qué haces, qué tuviste que hacer en un trabajo anterior, qué consiguiste y qué harás cuando termines tus estudios o proyecto actual.
exercises.model_answer: I work as a sales assistant and I'm responsible for the stock. At my previous job I had to get up at five every morning, but I managed to save a lot of money. When I finish my English course, I'll apply for a better position. As soon as I get a promotion, I'll look for a bigger flat. I'm good at working under pressure and I'm used to meeting tight deadlines.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

exercises.situation_es: Estás en una entrevista de trabajo.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: What were your responsibilities in your last job?

turns.speaker: You
choices: I was in charge of the customers' complaints, and I had to answer around thirty emails a day.
I was in charged of customers complaints and I must answer thirty emails each day.
I was responsible customers complaints and I had answer emails.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: What will you do as soon as you join the company?

turns.speaker: You
choices: As soon as I join, I'll meet the team and learn the system.
As soon as I will join I meet the team and I learn the system.
When I will join the company I'll to meet the team.
turns.why_es: As soon as + presente, will + verbo.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
